LabelSelector.description: Kubernetes-style label selector with match_labels and match_expressions.

matchExpressions.description: Set-based requirements a resource must satisfy, evaluated alongside `matchLabels`. Every requirement must hold.

matchLabels.description: Labels a resource must carry verbatim to match. Every entry must match; an empty map matches everything.

LabelSelectorRequirement.description: A single requirement for label selector expressions.

operator.description: How `values` is compared against the key: `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists`, or `DoesNotExist`.

values.description: Values the key is tested against. Required for `In` and `NotIn`, and must be empty for `Exists` and `DoesNotExist`.

ModuleRef.description: Reference to a module that should be installed on the machine.

name.description: Name of the cluster-scoped `Module` resource to install.

required.description: Whether a failure to resolve or install this module fails the whole reconcile. Default: `false`, so a missing module is reported and the rest of the machine still converges.

PackageRef.description: Reference to a package with optional version pin.

name.description: Package name as the machine's own package manager knows it.

version.description: Exact version to pin to. Omitted, whatever the manager currently offers is installed and left alone once present.

debugModules.description: Modules staged as debug-only (CSI volume without volumeMount on declared containers).

packages.description: Packages every selected MachineConfig must declare, each optionally version-pinned.

requiredModules.description: Modules every selected MachineConfig must carry. A machine missing one is counted non-compliant.

settings.description: System settings every selected MachineConfig must declare, keyed the same way as `MachineConfig.spec.systemSettings`.

targetSelector.description: Which MachineConfigs in this namespace the policy applies to. Empty, it applies to all of them.
